description: Purpose: the EU and China battery regulation timeline in one ordered view - applicability dates, legal bases and amendments, including conditional items. Guidelines: call first for any battery-regulation date question (passport, recycled content, due diligence, carbon footprint). Limits: dates are the applicability dates set in the regulation; items marked conditional apply only after the delegated act enters into force (later of the two triggers). Ex: get_battery_regulation_timeline(), get_battery_regulation_timeline(keyword='护照').
